g.text: An unconditional payment changed how people felt,

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #1c1a17

g.text: not just what they had — Finland

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: Finland's national basic income experiment, 2017–2018: €560/month, unconditional, paid to 2,000 randomly selected unemployed people.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: Employment effects were small; wellbeing effects were not — a 33% relative reduction in reported poor mental health among recipients.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Lora', 'Newsreader', 'Georgia', 'DejaVu Serif', serif; fill: #8a857b

g.text: Source: Kela / VATT Institute for Economic Research, official experiment results, 2020.
